name: Engineering Project Notion Links
type: AM Platform / Construction dashboard / Project navigation

dataIsolation.guard: Only the page.url returned with each project from the tenant-locked Projects data source is exposed on that scoped dashboard card.

definitionOfDone: Every visible engineering project card shows its own Notion link after the project name and chips
The summary API returns the project page URL without a hard-coded Notion ID
The link opens in a new tab with noopener isolation
Clicking the link does not trigger the project-card click handler
Projects without a URL do not render an empty link
Syntax, dashboard dry-run, package, and alignment verification pass
Production Render deployment and live project-card proof are recorded before status becomes Deployed
